content: How close is our facial nerve mesh to the dataset's published mesh?
Validation of ZETA, 13 row(s), run 19ac527c · pipeline v0.1.0 · QC pass_with_warnings

The facial nerve mesh is very close to the dataset's published mesh. The numbers below are for specimen ZETA, run 19ac527c, pipeline v0.1.0. The reference is the OpenEar 07_3D_Models .ply, converted from RAS to LPS.


| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Mean surface distance | 0.049 mm |
| 95th-percentile distance | 0.075 mm |
| Maximum distance | 0.344 mm |
| Volume difference | +1.06 % |
| Surface-area difference | +4.14 % |


- Most of the surface lies within about 0.05–0.08 mm of the reference. Only isolated points reach 0.34 mm.
- The facial nerve has one of the smallest mean distances of any structure in this run. The scala tympani is similar at 0.051 mm, and the chorda tympani is slightly higher at 0.055 mm.
- The surface area differs more than the volume does. That pattern is common when two meshes are smoothed differently, but I haven't checked the documentation for the cause here.
- This is one cadaveric specimen. The run's QC status is "pass_with_warnings".
